name: collaborative-chess
description: A collaborative chess game that runs on Cloudflare Workers using Durable Objects with GitHub Primer styling

scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run dev:watch & bunx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.build: bunx tsc && bunx terser dist/client.js -o public/client.js --compress --mangle && bunx terser dist/getPossibleMoves.js -o public/getPossibleMoves.js --compress --mangle && bunx terser dist/types.js -o public/types.js --compress --mangle && bunx terser dist/sw.js -o public/sw.js --compress --mangle && cp dist/client.d.ts public/ && cp dist/getPossibleMoves.d.ts public/
